sources.prompt: EDIT animation atlas: keep these TWO Yautja identities/costumes/heads/accessories and true transparency, redraw the LEGS and relaxed ARMS in EACH FRAME to create real walking. Current legs erroneously always show same near leg forward. It is ESSENTIAL to change this. No copy-pasting the standing reference legs. FOUR columns and FOUR rows; chief ROWS1(right)2(left), artisan ROWS3(right)4(left). All body/head sizes constant. A true four-phase side walk: COLUMN1 WIDE split stance near leg reaching FORWARD, far leg BACK; COLUMN2 very NARROW stance near planted foot DIRECTLY UNDER PELVIS, far KNEE RAISED FORWARD while FAR FOOT hangs above floor. COLUMN3 WIDE split stance OPPOSITE COLUMN1: NEAR thigh goes BACKWARD from HIP, NEAR knee and NEAR boot far BEHIND PELVIS, FAR LEG stretches FORWARD visibly from far hip. COLUMN4 narrow stance FAR planted foot UNDER PELVIS, NEAR KNEE RAISED FORWARD with near foot AIRBORNE. The two WIDE contact silhouettes must swap WHICH PHYSICAL LEG is forward. Columns2&4 silhouette MUST clearly be narrow, single planted supporting foot, opposite bent leg off floor. RIGHT rows front means image right; LEFT rows front means image left. Hands counter-swing with leading legs and shoulder accessories/staff stay attached to original correct hand. Staff can remain mostly grounded/chief robe partly covers knees but allow feet stepping inwards/outwards and alternate which foot is leading. Artisan apron parts naturally enough to see NEAR versus FAR leg switching sides; match her exact original identity and brown work apron, tool belt, forearm guards, two coherent clawhands, attached black dreads. Chief exact burgundy robe/bone mantle original localclan-chief, no Earthcrown. FOURROWS FOURCOLS with generous EMPTY ALPHA gutters separating EVERY fullycontainedfigure. Bodies occupy maximum75% eachcellheight, clear 20pxgaps from borders. Equal cell grid, fixed bodycenter/groundbaseline, orthographic southcamera35degree sameperspective. Native transparent RGBA square1536. No captions/no floor/no fakeanimationeffects.
